actions.analyze-document-async.descripti: Extract text, forms, tables and signatures from a multi-page PDF or TIFF, uploaded here or already in S3.
actions.analyze-document-async.props.cli: S3 files only. Same token and inputs within 7 days give the same job.
actions.analyze-document-async.props.fea: Choose what to extract. Tables: structured grid data. Forms: labelled fields and their values (e.g. "Name: John"). Signatures: signature locations. Layout: document structure like titles, headers, and sections.
actions.analyze-document-async.props.fil: Used when the source is a file. Its S3 copy is deleted after use.
actions.analyze-document-async.props.que: Ask plain-English questions about the document and get direct answers (e.g. "What is the invoice total?" or "What is the patient name?").
actions.analyze-document-async.props.s3B: A bucket in the same AWS region as your connection.
actions.analyze-document-async.props.s3K: Used when the source is S3, e.g. "reports/contract.pdf".
actions.analyze-document-async.props.sou: Upload a file, or use a file already in the bucket.
actions.analyze-document.description: Extract text, forms (key-value pairs), tables, and signatures from a document. Supports JPEG, PNG, and single-page PDF or TIFF, uploaded directly or from S3. For multi-page PDFs, use Analyze Document from S3 (Multi-Page) instead.
actions.analyze-document.props.featureTy: Select what to extract. TABLES extracts table data. FORMS extracts key-value pairs. SIGNATURES detects signatures.
actions.analyze-document.props.queries.d: Optional. Natural-language questions to ask about the document (e.g. "What is the patient name?"). When provided, the QUERIES feature is automatically enabled.
actions.analyze-document.props.source.de: Choose how to provide the document — upload a file directly or reference one already in S3.
actions.analyze-expense.description: Extract structured data from receipts and invoices: vendor name, totals, tax, line items, and more. Works best with clearly formatted receipts and invoices.
actions.analyze-expense.props.source.des: Choose how to provide the document — upload a file directly or reference one already in S3.
actions.analyze-id.description: Extract structured data from identity documents such as driver's licenses and passports. Returns fields like name, date of birth, ID number, and expiry date.
actions.analyze-id.props.source.descript: Choose how to provide the document — upload a file directly or reference one already in S3.
actions.detect-document-text.description: Extract plain text from a document. Faster and cheaper than Analyze Document — use this when you only need the text content without forms or tables. Supports JPEG, PNG, and single-page PDF or TIFF, uploaded directly or from S3.
actions.detect-document-text.props.sourc: Choose how to provide the document — upload a file directly or reference one already in S3.
description: Extract text, forms, tables, signatures, and structured data from documents using AWS Textract.
